verdicts.observation:
The target adds three hard line breaks that do not exist in the source (game/modules/tome/data/texts/tutorial/levelup.lua L24/L25/L30, commit 624a6732; each of those source lines is a single unbroken line). They are in '另外还能获得
不同的点数', '每等级你能获
得3个点数' and '怪物
来获得经验值'. The second one splits the word 获得 across two lines. The newline structure no longer matches the source, so the tutorial text will display broken mid-sentence. Remove these three extra newlines.

1) Newline mismatch: source L24 ('...all kinds of wild animals.') and L25 ('To the west lies...Kor'Pul...') are two separate lines (intro-higher.lua, commit 624a6732). The target merges them into one line ('...古老树林。向西走还有...'), so it has one fewer line break than the source. 2) Dropped superlative: 'the most powerful and respected lineage of men' is rendered as '拥有强大和受人尊敬的人类高贵血统'. The meaning of 'most' is lost, which weakens the description of the Higher as the most powerful and most respected lineage of men.
